record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
CamPlan gives you a fast, modern way to create 2D and 3D floor plans, room layouts, and interior design concepts with LiDAR scanning, AI design tools, detailed exports, and real-time collaboration.

Floor Plan Scanner & Creator
• LiDAR-based capture: Use your iPhone or iPad to scan a room. Walls, windows, doors, and measurements are detected automatically.
• 2D and 3D editing: Adjust layouts in a flat view or explore a rendered 3D model.
• AR preview: Place the virtual plan back into the real space to check scale and positioning.
• Detailed export options: Export floor plans as images, PDFs, 3D files, and professional formats including USDZ, OBJ, DXF, CAD, DAE, and more.
• Symbols & text: Add notes, labels, annotations, electrical symbols, and other plan details.
• Real-time collaboration: Share projects and work together with others on the same plan.
• Estimates: turn scanned floor plans into professional quotes with automatically measured quantities, reusable price lists, and AI-assisted line items. Review pricing, add taxes and markups, export branded PDFs, create invoices, and track payments.

AI Interior & Home Designer
• Photo-driven redesign: Snap a picture of any room and describe changes like “paint walls blue,” “add a reading nook,” or “switch to Scandinavian style.”
• Style guidance: Get ideas for colors, furniture, lighting, materials, and layouts that suit your space.
• Real-time updates: See design adjustments applied instantly.

Available on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, CamPlan offers an optimized interface with platform-specific gestures for a seamless experience. Enjoy accessibility support, including light and dark modes.

CamPlan is ideal for homeowners, real estate agents, electricians, renovators, interior designers, contractors, and architects.

CamPlan Plus, Pro and Business are available as auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. You will continue to receive full functionality until the end of your current subscription period, but unused portions cannot be refunded.

Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://camplan.ai/terms

record.description_evidence:
Roomture redesigns your home from a single photo — indoors, outdoors, and everything in the garden.

Take a picture of your space, pick a style, and watch it transform in seconds. Keep the room's existing structure, or let the AI reimagine it completely. You decide which.

NINE WAYS TO REDESIGN
• Interior Design — 30 styles, from Japandi and Coastal to Baroque and Cyberpunk
• Exterior Design — 24 styles for facades, villas, cabins and porches
• Garden Design — 24 styles for backyards, courtyards, patios and poolsides
• Layout Boost — the same room with a smarter furniture arrangement
• Paint — try a wall color before you buy a can
• New Floor — swap the flooring and watch the room change with it
• Reference Style — show the AI a look you love, get it applied to your space
• Replace Object — describe one change; everything else stays untouched
• Cleanup — clear the clutter and see the room without it

78 STYLES ACROSS 28 SPACES
Indoors: kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom, dining room, home office, study, attic, hall, balcony, gaming room, coffee shop and more.
Outdoors: house facade, villa, townhouse, cabin, porch and entry.
Garden: backyard, front yard, patio and deck, courtyard, kitchen garden, poolside.

Fine-tune any result with 10 color palettes and 12 floor materials.

BEFORE AND AFTER
Every design keeps your original photo, so you can drag the slider and see exactly what changed.

KEEP WHAT YOU LIKE
Save a design to your photo library, share it, or keep refining it — change the paint, swap the floor, or replace one piece of furniture without touching the rest.

New accounts include 4 free designs — no subscription needed.

ROOMTURE PRO
• 50 redesigns every 12 hours
• No watermark on your designs
• Our highest-quality AI model
• Priority queue — skip the wait

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store subscription settings.

YOUR PHOTOS
The photos you pick are uploaded only so the AI can redesign them. They are never used to train models and never sold. Delete a design and its photos go with it — or delete your account and everything with it, right from Settings.

record.description_evidence:
archelier (ar-shə-LYAY) is Architect + Atelier — a design studio that fits in your pocket. Point your camera at a room you are tired of, pick a style, and get back a photorealistic redesign of that exact space, with every piece of furniture named and linked.

No subscription. Everyone gets 3 designs free every day.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Photograph the room — or upload a sketch, a floor plan, or a 3D screenshot
2. Pick a style, or describe one in your own words
3. Get a photoreal render of your space, plus a furniture list, color palette, and lighting plan

38 STYLES, THREE KINDS OF SPACE
• Interior — Modern, Scandinavian, IKEA, Japandi, Industrial, Coastal, Classic, Art Deco, Mid-Century Modern, Maximalist, Vintage, Bohemian, Tropical, Cottagecore, Rustic, Wabi-Sabi, Gothic, Cyberpunk, Taisho Romance, Biophilic, Cozy, Gaming
• Exterior — facades, farmhouse, Mediterranean, Craftsman, Tudor, Cape Cod, mountain cabin and more
• Garden — Zen, cottage, desert, tropical, English

FOUR MODES BEYOND STYLES
• Custom Style — describe the look in a sentence and save it for reuse
• Reference — upload a photo you love and borrow its look
• Cleanup — clear the clutter and see the room bare
• Layout — rearrange what is already there instead of replacing it

CHANGE ONE THING AT A TIME
Not happy with just the sofa? Circle it and type what you want instead. archelier repaints only that region and leaves the rest of the room untouched. Same for wall color, rugs, lighting, and artwork.

SHOP WHAT YOU SEE
Every furniture suggestion comes with a search link — Naver Shopping in Korea, Google Shopping everywhere else — so a render turns into a shopping list.

ASK FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS
The design advisor knows the room it just made. Ask why it chose that palette, what fits a smaller budget, or how to light it at night.

CREDITS, NOT A SUBSCRIPTION
• 3 free designs every day, refreshed at your local midnight
• 5 bonus designs when you create an account
• Invite a friend and you both get 10 more — the bonus never expires

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
iPhone and the web at archelier.co. Your designs stay in sync between them.

PRIVACY
We do not track you across other apps. Your photos and prompts are never used to train AI models, and your designs stay private to your account unless you share a link.

Powered by Google Gemini.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://archelier.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://archelier.co/privacy

record.description_evidence:
Dimora is your personal AI interior designer. Photograph any room and it comes back redesigned — with a written note explaining every choice, and a complete plan of what it takes to build it.

Then Dimora does the thing other AI room apps don't: it furnishes your design with real products from real furniture stores in your own country, and rebuilds the photo around those exact pieces. Real product names. Real prices in your currency. Real links to the shop. The room you are looking at is a room you can actually order.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Photograph your room, or pick a photo from your library.
2. Choose from 14 styles — Japandi, Luxury Modern, Scandinavian, Parisian, Art Deco, Mid-Century, Coastal, Industrial and more.
3. Set your budget on the slider, and tap what stays — your couch, your flooring, your TV. Your designer works around what you already own.
4. Your designed room arrives in moments, with a designer's note and a full build plan.
5. Tap "Source the pieces" and Dimora finds the real products, in real stores near you, and re-renders your room using them.

REAL PRODUCTS, REAL STORES, YOUR COUNTRY

Dimora shops where you shop. In 30 markets it searches the stores that actually operate there, in the language those stores publish in, and prices everything in your currency: IKEA, Home Centre, Danube Home, Amazon.ae and Marina Home in the Gulf. John Lewis, Dunelm and Habitat in the UK. Wayfair, West Elm, Crate & Barrel and Article in the US. OTTO, home24 and Westwing in Germany. Maisons du Monde and La Redoute in France. Pepperfry and Urban Ladder in India. Castlery and HipVan in Singapore. Mio, JYSK, Bolia and Nordic Nest across the Nordics — and many more.

Every piece is a real listing with a photo, a real price, and a link straight to the store page.

A DESIGN YOU CAN ACTUALLY BUILD

• A build plan, not a picture — every piece grouped like a designer's spec sheet, with prices and a running total against your budget.
• Tap anything in the photo — the sofa, the rug, the lamp — and see what it is, what it costs, why your designer chose it, and where to buy it.
• Swap any piece for a budget, standard or premium alternative. The total recalculates instantly.
• Replace a single object visually. Don't like the sofa? Pick another and only the sofa changes — same walls, same light, same everything else.
• Check pieces off as you buy them. Every room shows how far along it is and exactly what's left to spend.
• Pieces you already own are marked "You own this — $0", so your budget only counts what you actually need to buy.

TALK TO YOUR DESIGNER

Every room has a conversation. Say "make it brighter", "warmer colours", "replace only the rug", "I have cats", "make it rental friendly" — and the room and the plan both change in response. Unlimited on every membership.

KEEP EVERY ROOM ORGANISED

Name and save every design, and group rooms by place — your apartment, your parents' house, a villa, the office — each with its own rooms, total invested and remaining spend. Compare before and after with a drag-to-reveal slider, play a cinematic reveal, and share or save the result.

MEMBERSHIP

Your first design is free, sourcing included.

• Designer — $29.99/month, 20 designs a month
• Designer Annual — $269.99/year, 20 designs a month (save 25%)
• Studio — $79.99/month, 60 designs a month, for professionals
• Or a one-time pack of 5 designs

Chat, swaps, object replacements, palette changes and your build checklists are unlimited on every membership. A design is one new room render plus its full sourcing pass; refining a design never costs another.

Memberships renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://getdimora.app/privacy
